description: Delete a contact label by ID. The label is removed from every contact that has it and from the inbox filters; the contacts themselves are not touched. Run get_labels first to find the ID.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to delete the label.

label_id.description: ID of the label to delete

name: delete_label
